name_reality_gap: Labeled as 'Construction Repair & Maintenance Services' which is reductive. Burns & McDonnell is primarily an engineering firm — one of the largest employee-owned AEC firms in the US — that designs and then builds infrastructure. The construction is the downstream execution of the engineering work; the firm's market position comes from engineering capability and integrated delivery, not repair and maintenance.
